description: Pôle Vie Quotidienne - Points arrêt routiers RÉMI is a dataset listed in Portail Open Data de la CC Autour de Chenonceaux Bléré-Val de Cher, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Région Centre-Val de Loire. Ce jeu de données est supprimé car plus maintenu. Il est remplacé par: REMI - Points d'arrêts routiers Ce jeu de données concerne l'ensemble des points d'arrêt routiers desservis par le réseau de transport routier régional (réseau scolaire et commercial). Coverage: Autour de Chenonceaux (Indre-et-Loire). The portal files it under Mobilité, geospatial. Its keywords are mobilité, Rémi, transport, ramassage scolaire, interurbain, lignes régulières. The portal shows 2026-02-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-cc-autourdechenonceaux-fr-portal.
